HediffDef.label: refracted stardust
HediffDef.description: Astral bulwark stores part of the damage it stops. Your next direct hit spends the stored stardust as electrical damage shared between the target and up to two nearby enemies. Stardust expires after eight seconds or when the bulwark is removed.

HediffDef.label: astral isolation
HediffDef.description: After three qualifying enemy hits in two seconds, Astral bulwark prevents new enemy direct damage for0.6seconds. The triggering hit is still taken normally. This protection can return after twelve seconds.
